<thought>Using the most intense peak at m/z 193.1103 as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is 192.1030 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₉H₁₂N₄O (exact mass 192.1011 Da, error ≈ 10 ppm). This fits the required CxHyOzX format.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H12N4O</final_answer>
